body:
Normal `mori simulate` discarded errors from the shared Core header reader and fell back to a Core/1 diagnostic, despite supporting Core/2. Preserve the existing reader error before selecting the profile.

Adds an ordinary public regression for unknown, missing and Unicode-commented headers, with complete process captures and an empty Core/2 control. Stacked on PR246; accepted source profiles and the native trace path retain their existing behavior.

Validation: the new aggregate failed before the repair and passed afterward; existing exact Core/1 logical-meter and Core/2 continuation positive tests passed. Rustfmt and whitespace checks passed. The capture comparison preserves UTF-8 offsets 16/9/25 and exact human streams. These expectations are source-exposed ordinary diagnostics. Independent review is pending; compiler, proof and ledger tiers were not run.


Delivered to `main` by #252 (merge `370e4fa598dfaea05de9da5e2b15cd436161b450`). Both changed files are byte-identical to this PR’s candidate. This stacked delivery PR is superseded; its branch and evidence history are preserved. The separate financial/help/docs work and broader product acceptance remain open.
title: Preserve Core header diagnostics in normal simulation
